articles.summary: Here's the pattern I keep seeing. A director asks whether their team needs a "Prompt Engineer" or an "AI Ops" hire. Six months later, it turns out nobody needed a new title — they needed three existing roles to absorb a new skill.
articles.title: Job Architecture in the Age of AI: When Should You Redesign a Role?

articles.summary: In our latest webinar, Chad Atwell, Head of Customer Success & Advisory at CandorIQ, sat down with Kathryn Gombos, Founder & Managing Director of Gombos Group, to talk about what organizational readiness actually looks like—and why workforce planning needs to go much further than deciding how many people to hire next year.
articles.title: Organizational Readiness: Is Your People Strategy Ready for 2027?

articles.summary: Here's a stat that should stop you mid-scroll: tech companies have cut more than 210,000 jobs so far in 2026 — already past all of 2025, with months still to go. Oracle alone has eliminated close to 30,000 roles. Amazon, Meta, Microsoft followed. And almost every one of them said the same thing: this isn't about a bad quarter. It's AI.
articles.title: The Layoffs Aren't Slowing Down. Neither Should Your Headcount Plan.
